equipment_type: Split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric residential, Mr. Slim and City Multi indoor units with a CN105 (or CN92) connector.
summary: One-unit Intesis interface that plugs into the CN105 socket of a Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit and exposes it on BACnet MS/TP as 31 fixed objects. Each function has a _command object to write and a _status object to read back. It includes left/right vane control, occupancy logic, a remote-controller lock and a virtual-temperature function that uses a BMS room sensor.
notes: This MS/TP model has more objects than the older INBACMIT001I000 gateway (BACnet IP and MS/TP, listed separately): left/right vane, RoomTemperature_command, virtual temperature, DIP switch status and serial number are added.

Object names are taken from each object's Object_Name property; the summary table spells some with different capitals (UserSetpoint_status, Setpoint_command, the occupancy setpoints, UnoccupiedDeadBandAction).

AirDirectionLR_command gives Present_Value 1..6 and Number_Of_States 6 in its property table, but its state table shows 7 states (Pos1-Pos6 Wide, Swing) like the status object; the state table is used here.
Fan Speed 1 is the Silent speed on units that have it; available fan speeds and vane positions depend on the indoor unit.
Temperature units follow the °C/°F DIP switch (SW2 position 8).

source.title: IN485MIT001I000 Gateway - Mitsubishi Electric Residential, Mr. Slim, and City Multi Systems to BACnet MS/TP - User Manual

integration.summary: Plug the gateway into the indoor unit's CN105 socket (CN92 on some units), set the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate on the DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan, vanes) and read the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point is documented; the gateway accepts commands as soon as it talks to the unit. BV 2 LockRemoteControl can lock out the wired remote.
integration.remote_sensors: Write the BMS room temperature to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command and the setpoint to AO 0. The gateway then runs its Virtual Temperature function and recalculates the setpoint it sends to the unit; BI 14 VirtualTempActive shows it is active and AI 17 UserSetPoint_status shows the BMS setpoint.
setup: Default device instance 246000; in automatic mode it is 246000 + the MS/TP MAC address set on DIP switch SW2.
Writing Object_Identifier from BACnet switches the gateway to manual addressing until a factory reset.
Baud rate is set on SW1 P6-P8; autobaud is the default.
SW3 enables the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing.
DIP switch changes take effect only after a reboot.
gotchas: Write the _command object and read the _status object; they share instance numbers in different object types.
The Occupancy MV and its four setpoint AVs drive built-in logic; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) if the BMS handles scheduling.
The setpoint range on this model is 16-31.5 °C (61-88.7 °F).
